name: Odin
title: All-Father
summary: Drain your foes of their Divinity and bring about Ragnarok with powerful Disables.
lore: Odin, the All-Father, King of Asgard, is believed by many to be nearly all-powerful and all-knowing. Yet some strange preoccupation came over him in the years preceding the Shattering, a distance and distraction that have only grown in the time since. He often disappears, leaving governing to others, and none in his pantheon know where he goes, what he does, or why.

skills.name: Laying Claim
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 370%ATK with an 80% chance to decrease the target’s Divinity by 10%. If the target is under [Charm] or [Confuse], steal 10% of the target’s Divinity instead.

skills.name: Hunting Party
skills.description:
Attack all enemies 3 times 120%ATK. The first hit has a 75% chance to place [Confuse] on each target for 1 turn.
The second hit has a 75% chance to place [Lock Passive] on each target for 2 turns.
The third hit has a 75% chance to increase the rank of all Debuff on each target by 1.

Additionally, if Geri or Freki are on the team, increase their Turn Meter by 100%.

skills.name: Ragnarok
skills.description:
Attack all enemies 305%ATK and equalize the Divinity of each enemy to the enemy with the lowest Divinity. If there is only 1 enemy, decrease the target’s Divinity by 30% instead.

If the target’s Divinity is reduced below 50%, has an 80% chance to place [Confuse] on the target for 1 turn. If the target’s Divinity is above 50% has an 80% chance to place [FTH Down II] on the target for 2 turns.
